mUtrASayaH strIRAM garBASayo'zwama iti AmASayasTAnaeva dozarUpa SlezmasTAnaM yaToktaM suSru॰ । “dozasTAnAnyata UrdDaM vakzyAmaH tatra samAsena vAtaHSroRigudasaMSrayaH । SroRigudayoruparyyAnABi pakvASayaH pakvASayamaDyaM pittasya । AmASayaH SlezmaRaH । tacca sTAnaM nirRRItaM BAvapra॰ yaTA “agnivegavahaH prARogudAntre pratihanyate । sa UrdDvamAgamya punaH samutkzipati pAvakam । pakvASayastvaDonAByAmUrdDamAmASayaH sTitaH । nABimaDye SarIrasya prARAH nityaM pratizWitAH” carake tu “nABisTAnottaraM jantorAhurAmASayaM buDAH” iti atra viSezamAha “uroraktASayastasmAdaDaHSlezmASayaH smftaH । AmASayastu tadaDastadaDo'nnASayomataH” iti apakvASaya prasaNgAt AhArapAkaprakArastAvaducyate BAvaprakASe suSrutaH “yo vAyuH prARanAmAsO muKaM gacCati dehaDfk so'ntaHpraveSya gacCettaM pacatyAmASayasTitam । Odaryyo'gnirTaTA bAhyaH sTAlIsTaM toyataRqulamiti” prARavAyunA preritastataH kiYciccalitaH pAcakAKyapittozmaRezatpakvo Bavati uktaM ca “aTa pAcakapittena vidagDaScAmlatAM vrajediti” pAcakapittena pAcakapitta syozmaRA tataH evAhAronAmimaRqalADizWAnena samAnanAmnA vAyunA preritograhaRIM prati yAti uktaM ca । “tataHsamAnamarutA grahaRImaBiDAvati” । grahaRIlakzaRamAha “zazWI pittaDarA nAma yA kalA parikIrttitA । AmapakvASayAntaHsTA grahaRI sABiDIyate” pittaDarA pAcakAKyaM pittaM yadagnyaDizWAnaM tadDArayati tatra grahaRyAmAmASayapakvASaya maDyavarttipAcakAKyapittADizWAnenAgninAhAraH pacyate sa kawuSca Bavati taTA ca “grahaRyAM pacyate kozWavahninA jAyate kawuriti” । ayamarTaH AhArograhaRyAM kozWavahninA grahaRIsTitapAcakapittasTe na ca vahninA pacyate pacyamAnaH sa grahaRIsTitasya kawurasasya pittayogAtkawurBavati etadAhArapAke viSepamAha SarIraM pAYcaBOtikaM tatra paYcasu BUtezu paYcAgnayastizWanti uktaM ca carake “BOmApyAgneyavAyavyAH paYcopmARaH । sanABasAH paYcAhAraguRAn svAn svAn pArTivAdIn pacantyataH” । atrozmapadenAgnirucyate AhAro'pi pAYcaBOtikaH tatra pAcakapittasTenAgninottejitena SarIravarttiBUBAgaH pacyate pakvoBUBAgaH svakIyAn guRAnaBibardDayati evaM jalAdiBAgA api pacyante taTA ca suSrute “paYcaBUtAtmako deha AhAraH pAYcaBOtikaH । vipakvaM paYcaDA samyagguRAnsvAnaBibardDayediti” guRaSabdenAtra guRinaH pfTivyAdaya ucyante tena guRAn SarIravarttinaH pArTivAdIn BAgAnaBivardDayediti evamahorAtreRa pakva AhAromizwaH kawuSca maDuro Bavati amlo'mlo Bapati kawutiktaHkazAyaSca kawurBavati uktaM ca “mizwaH kawuSca maDuro'TAmlo'mlaH pacyate rasaH । kawutiktakazAyARAM vipAko jAyate kawuriti” evaM vipakvasyAhArasya sAro rasaSezograhaRisTo mala iva malaH । asya jalaBAgaH SiRaBirvastinnItomUtraM Bavati uktaM ca “AhArasya rasaH sAraHsArahInomaladravaH । SirABistajjalaM nItaM vastiMmUtratvamApnuyAt । SezaM kIwwaM Bavettasya tat purIzaM nigadyate । samAnavAyunA nItaM tattizWati malASaye” tatra malASayAlayenApAnavAyunA preritaM mUtraM meQraBagamArgeRa, purIzaM gudamArgeRa, SarIrAdbahiryAti । uktaM ca “mUtrantUpasTamArgeRa, purIzaM gudamArgataH । apAnavAyunA kziptaM bahiryAti SarIrataH” ।
